news.titleEn: Oil surges above $95 on renewed US-Iran fighting and Hormuz disruption concerns
news.conclusionEn: Brent crude held above $95 a barrel and WTI near $91 on Sept. 2 after both benchmarks jumped more than $4 the previous day, as fresh US-Iran military exchanges near the Strait of Hormuz revived fears of a lasting oil-supply shock.
news.conclusionZh: 9月2日布伦特原油守在95美元上方、WTI逼近91美元，美伊在霍尔木兹海峡再度交火，重燃供应冲击担忧。
news.whyEn: About a fifth of the world's seaborne oil moves through Hormuz, so sustained fighting keeps a risk premium in crude that feeds straight into inflation, pump prices and central-bank rate decisions worldwide.
news.whyZh: 全球约五分之一海运石油经霍尔木兹海峡运输，持续冲突让油价维持风险溢价，直接推升各国通胀、油价和加息压力。
news.detailEn: President Trump said US forces struck Iranian targets near the strait in response to Iranian attempts to lay sea mines and eight missiles fired at a US base in Jordan, and Iran vowed to retaliate. Kuwait, Jordan and Bahrain intercepted missiles on Wednesday morning. Commodity-vessel transits through Hormuz have collapsed to about five a day from 23 a week earlier and roughly 85 before the conflict. Analysts say crude is likely to stay elevated as long as tanker traffic remains disrupted, keeping upward pressure on global bond yields and consumer prices.
news.detailZh: 特朗普称美军空袭霍尔木兹海峡附近的伊朗目标，以回应伊朗试图布设水雷并向约旦美军基地发射8枚导弹，伊朗誓言报复。科威特、约旦和巴林在周三上午拦截了导弹。经海峡的商品船通行量已从一周前每天约23艘、战前约85艘骤降至约5艘。分析人士称，只要油轮通行仍受扰乱，油价就可能维持高位，持续推高全球债券收益率和消费者物价。

news.titleEn: U.S. 10-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2023
news.conclusionEn: The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield reached 4.814% intraday on Sept. 2, its highest since November 2023, as a global bond sell-off driven by the oil-price spike and inflation fears pushed Germany's 10-year yield to about 3.39%, likely a decade high.
news.conclusionZh: 9月2日10年期美债收益率盘中触及4.814%，为2023年11月以来最高；全球债券遭抛售，德国10年期收益率升至约3.39%。
news.whyEn: Higher long-term yields raise the cost of mortgages, corporate debt and government deficits everywhere, and force investors to discount company earnings more aggressively, pressuring richly valued stocks.
news.whyZh: 长期收益率走高推高各国房贷、企业债和政府赤字的融资成本，也迫使投资者更狠地折现企业盈利，打压高估值股票。
news.detailEn: WTI crude above $90 and Brent near $95, roughly $20 higher than before the Iran conflict, have kept energy-driven inflation fears alive and complicated central-bank policy. Traders increasingly expect rate hikes this month in the US and Europe. Strategists warn that a sustained move higher in yields would weigh on equity valuations and on any part of the economy that relies on borrowing. Friday's US August jobs report is the next major test for the bond market.
news.detailZh: WTI原油站上90美元、布伦特逼近95美元，较伊朗冲突前高出约20美元，令能源推动的通胀担忧挥之不去，也让央行政策更棘手。交易员越来越预期美欧本月加息。策略师警告，收益率若持续走高，将压制股票估值和所有依赖借贷的经济环节。周五的美国8月就业报告是债市的下一个大考。

news.titleEn: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq edge higher as bond yields pause climb
news.conclusionEn: US stocks snapped a three-day losing streak on Sept. 2, with the Dow up about 0.6%, the S&P 500 up 0.5% and the Nasdaq up 0.4%, after oil gains stalled and New York Fed chief John Williams said there were no clear signs a September rate hike is needed.
news.conclusionZh: 9月2日美股终结三连跌，道指涨约0.6%、标普500涨0.5%、纳指涨0.4%，油价涨势停滞、纽约联储主席威廉姆斯淡化9月加息必要性。
news.whyEn: The bounce shows how tightly equity sentiment is now tied to the oil price and to conflicting Fed signals, leaving the market vulnerable to swings from the Middle East and from Friday's payrolls data.
news.whyZh: 反弹显示股市情绪已高度绑定油价和美联储的矛盾信号，令市场易受中东局势和周五就业数据的冲击。
news.detailEn: Williams' remarks partly offset hawkish comments from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh at Jackson Hole and helped the 10-year yield ease back to around 4.79%. ADP data showing just 38,000 private-sector jobs added in August was read as a soft signal ahead of the government jobs report. Dell jumped about 10% to 15% on record AI server orders, and peer Hewlett Packard Enterprise also rallied. Investors remain focused on whether the Fed hikes on Sept. 17 for the first time this cycle.
news.detailZh: 威廉姆斯的表态部分抵消了美联储主席沃什在杰克逊霍尔的鹰派言论，帮助10年期收益率回落至约4.79%。ADP显示8月私营部门仅增3.8万个岗位，被视为政府就业报告前的疲软信号。戴尔因AI服务器订单创纪录跳涨约10%至15%，同业慧与也走高。投资者仍聚焦美联储是否会在9月17日启动本轮首次加息。

news.titleEn: Markets see Warsh endorsing a rate hike in September. Not everyone is convinced
news.conclusionEn: Fed funds futures now price a roughly 58% to 60% chance of a 25-basis-point Fed rate hike at the September meeting, up from about 35% before Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole speech, though several analysts argue the economy lacks the momentum to justify it.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储主席沃什在杰克逊霍尔发表鹰派讲话后，期货market对9月加息25个基点的押注从约35%升至约58%-60%，但多位分析师认为经济动能不足以支撑加息。
news.whyEn: A US rate hike would be the first of this cycle and a sharp reversal after a long easing phase, lifting global borrowing costs and putting the Fed at odds with both President Trump and, potentially, the US Treasury.
news.whyZh: 美国若加息将是本轮首次、也是长期宽松后的急转弯，会抬高全球借贷成本，并令美联储与特朗普乃至财政部产生分歧。
news.detailEn: Warsh, on his 100th day as chair, warned that stubborn inflation tied to the energy shock could push the Fed to tighten. Critics note the labor market shows little sign of inflationary pressure, with ADP payrolls slowing and hiring cooling. New York Fed President John Williams pushed back on Sept. 2, saying there were 'no clear signs' a hike is needed now. The decision comes at the Sept. 17 meeting, with Friday's jobs report seen as pivotal.
news.detailZh: 上任第100天的沃什警告，与能源冲击相关的顽固通胀可能促使美联储收紧。批评者指出劳动力市场几乎没有通胀压力迹象，ADP就业放缓、招聘降温。纽约联储主席威廉姆斯9月2日反驳称，目前「没有明确迹象」需要加息。决议将在9月17日会议作出，周五的就业报告被视为关键。

news.titleEn: Euro zone inflation is back above 3%. Higher interest rates are likely to follow
news.conclusionEn: Euro-area annual inflation rose to 3.3% in August from 2.9% in July, the highest since September 2024, and markets now price a near-certain 25-basis-point European Central Bank rate hike to 2.5% at the Sept. 10 meeting.
news.conclusionZh: 欧元区8月通胀率从7月的2.9%升至3.3%，为2024年9月以来最高，市场几乎笃定欧洲央行将在9月10日加息25个基点至2.5%。
news.whyEn: A second ECB hike in three months would confirm that Europe's long easing cycle has flipped to tightening because of the energy shock, adding to the global rise in bond yields and to pressure on growth.
news.whyZh: 三个月内第二次加息将证实欧洲长期宽松周期因能源冲击转为收紧，加剧全球债券收益率上行和增长压力。
news.detailEn: Energy inflation accelerated to 14.3% year over year, while core inflation eased to 2.4%. Spain recorded the highest headline rate among big economies at 4.5%, followed by Italy, Germany and France. The ECB raised rates in June for the first time since 2023. President Christine Lagarde has said inflation is expected to stay 'well above target' into the first half of 2027, and some economists think September will not be the last hike of the cycle.
news.detailZh: 能源通胀同比升至14.3%，核心通胀回落至2.4%。大型经济体中西班牙整体通胀率最高，达4.5%，其后为意大利、德国和法国。欧洲央行6月自2023年以来首次加息。行长拉加德表示，通胀预计将「远高于目标」持续至2027年上半年，一些经济学家认为9月不会是本轮最后一次加息。

news.titleEn: ADP National Employment Report: Private-Sector Employment Increased by 38,000 Jobs in August
news.conclusionEn: US private employers added just 38,000 jobs in August, below the roughly 47,000 expected and the slowest pace since January, with manufacturing (-17,000) and professional and business services (-16,000) shedding roles even as education and health services added 45,000.
news.conclusionZh: 美国8月私营部门仅增3.8万个岗位，低于预期约4.7万，为1月以来最慢；制造业减1.7万、专业和商业服务减1.6万，教育与医疗增4.5万。
news.whyEn: A cooling labor market undercuts the case for a September Fed rate hike and heightens the stakes for Friday's official jobs report, which will shape both the Fed decision and the direction of bond yields.
news.whyZh: 劳动力市场降温削弱了9月加息的理由，也抬高了周五官方就业报告的分量，该数据将左右美联储决议和债券收益率走向。
news.detailEn: Large establishments drove the gains, adding 34,000 jobs, while medium-sized firms added none. Base pay rose 3.2% year over year for all workers and 4.7% for job-changers. ADP chief economist Nela Richardson said pay growth is being 'overtaken by complexities of demographic change, persistent inflation, and AI's effects on jobs.' The report lands the same week as ISM surveys, JOLTS openings and the government's August payrolls release.
news.detailZh: 大型企业贡献主要增量，增加3.4万个岗位，中型企业零增长。所有员工基本薪资同比涨3.2%，跳槽者涨4.7%。ADP首席经济学家理查森称，薪资增长正「被人口结构变化、顽固通胀和AI对岗位的影响所压过」。该报告与ISM调查、JOLTS职位空缺及政府8月就业数据在同一周公布。

news.conclusionEn: Broadcom's fiscal Q3 revenue jumped about 86% year over year to $29.6 billion with adjusted EPS of $3.32, both beating forecasts, as AI chip revenue more than tripled to $16.7 billion, but the stock fell after hours on a Q4 revenue guide of about $34.8 billion, just shy of the $35 billion expected.
news.conclusionZh: 博通财季营收同比增约86%至296亿美元，调整后每股收益3.32美元，均超预期，AI芯片收入增两倍多至167亿美元；但第四季度营收指引约348亿美元略低于预期，盘后股价下跌。
news.whyEn: Broadcom is a bellwether for custom AI chip demand from cloud giants, so a rare guidance miss raises fresh questions about the pace of the AI capital-spending boom just as rising yields squeeze high-valuation tech.
news.whyZh: 博通是云巨头定制AI芯片需求的风向标，罕见的指引不及预期重新引发对AI资本开支热潮节奏的疑问，而收益率上升正挤压高估值科技股。
news.detailEn: Management guided Q4 AI semiconductor revenue to about $21.7 billion and projected full-year fiscal 2026 AI chip revenue near $58 billion, up about 186%. Executives reiterated a 'line of sight' to roughly $115 billion of AI chip revenue in fiscal 2027. The results followed Dell's blockbuster AI server report the same day, underscoring that AI infrastructure demand remains strong even as investors turn more selective on valuations and forward guidance.
news.detailZh: 管理层将第四季度AI半导体收入指引定在约217亿美元，并预计2026财年全年AI芯片收入约580亿美元、同比增约186%。高管重申2027财年AI芯片收入「已有清晰路径」达约1150亿美元。该财报与戴尔当天强劲的AI服务器业绩前后脚公布，表明在投资者对估值和前瞻指引更挑剔之际，AI基础设施需求依然旺盛。

news.titleEn: Dell stock surges on record orders for AI servers
news.conclusionEn: Dell shares jumped roughly 10% to 15% on Sept. 2 after posting record fiscal Q2 revenue of $47 billion (up 58% year over year) and EPS of $6.34, booking a record $60.9 billion in AI server orders and a $95 billion backlog, and raising its full-year revenue outlook by $25 billion to $192 billion.
news.conclusionZh: 戴尔9月2日股价跳涨约10%至15%，财季营收创纪录达470亿美元（同比增58%），每股收益6.34美元，AI服务器订单达609亿美元、积压订单950亿美元，并将全年营收展望上调250亿美元至1920亿美元。
news.whyEn: Dell's numbers are hard evidence that enterprise and hyperscaler spending on AI hardware is still accelerating, supporting chipmakers and server suppliers even as broader tech valuations wobble on higher rates.
news.whyZh: 戴尔的数据是企业和超大规模客户AI硬件支出仍在加速的硬证据，即便更广泛的科技估值因利率上升而动摇，也支撑芯片和服务器供应商。
news.detailEn: Adjusted EPS rose 203% to $7.04, and Dell lifted its full-year adjusted EPS target to $25.50 from $17.90. The stock is up more than 230% year to date, and peer Hewlett Packard Enterprise has more than doubled in 2026. CFO David Kennedy said momentum 'continues' across every line of business. The report helped steady sentiment in AI-linked shares hours before Broadcom's own results.
news.detailZh: 调整后每股收益增203%至7.04美元，戴尔将全年调整后每股收益目标从17.90美元上调至25.50美元。该股今年迄今涨超230%，同业慧与2026年已翻倍。首席财务官肯尼迪称各业务线的势头「仍在延续」。这份财报在博通业绩公布前数小时帮助稳住了AI相关股票的情绪。

news.titleEn: Uber is laying off 10% of staff, or 3,300 people
news.conclusionEn: Uber said on Sept. 2 it will cut about 3,300 jobs, roughly 10% of its global workforce, reducing management roles by 20%, eliminating half of its one- and two-person teams, capping remote work at under 1% of staff and merging its engineering, science and delivery divisions.
news.conclusionZh: 优步9月2日宣布裁员约3300人，占全球员工约10%，管理岗位削减20%，取消半数「一两人小组」，远程办公限制在1%以内，并合并工程、科学和配送部门。
news.whyEn: One of the gig economy's largest employers cutting deep into middle management is a visible sign that big tech is still trimming layers and headcount, and pushing workers back to offices, three years into the AI efficiency drive.
news.whyZh: 作为零工经济最大雇主之一，优步大幅削减中层管理，是大型科技公司在AI提效三年后仍在压缩层级和人手、并推动员工回办公室的明显信号。
news.detailEn: CEO Dara Khosrowshahi told staff the company had become too complex, with 'more layers, more coordination, more fragmented ownership.' Positions more than seven layers below the CEO are being removed, and some managers will move to individual-contributor roles. It is Uber's largest cut since 2020, when the pandemic forced about 6,700 job losses. The company framed the move as freeing up resources to invest in ride-hailing, delivery and robotaxis.
news.detailZh: 首席执行官科斯罗萨希告诉员工，公司已变得过于复杂，「层级更多、协调更多、责任更分散」。距CEO超过七层的岗位将被裁撤，部分管理者将转为个人贡献者。这是优步自2020年疫情导致约6700人失业以来最大规模裁员。公司称此举是为腾出资源投入网约车、配送和无人出租车业务。

news.titleEn: Putin and Zelenskyy issue threats as strikes rock Ukraine, Russia
news.conclusionEn: Russia fired 174 attack drones and four missiles at Ukraine overnight into Sept. 2, hitting Kyiv for a seventh straight day and killing at least one person, while Ukrainian drone strikes on Russia's Belgorod region killed two, and both leaders escalated their rhetoric with no path to a ceasefire in sight.
news.conclusionZh: 9月2日凌晨俄罗斯向乌克兰发射174架攻击无人机和4枚导弹，连续第七天袭击基辅、至少1人死亡；乌克兰无人机袭击俄别尔哥罗德致2人死亡，双方领导人言辞升级，停火无望。
news.whyEn: The war is now in its fifth year with the front line deadlocked, and Zelenskyy's warning that Russian airspace is becoming unsafe for civil aviation could disrupt flight routes and raise insurance costs for global airlines.
news.whyZh: 战争进入第五年，前线陷入僵局；泽连斯基警告俄罗斯领空对民航正变得不安全，可能扰乱航线并推高全球航空公司的保险成本。
news.detailEn: Zelenskyy said Russian airspace would 'effectively be closing' because of expanding Ukrainian long-range drone attacks, a move aimed at pressuring Moscow toward talks. Putin accused Kyiv of 'state terrorism' and said 'we don't negotiate with terrorists,' and was evasive when asked whether Russia would strike British military sites if the UK keeps arming Ukraine. US-led negotiation efforts have so far produced no breakthrough, and both sides are digging in for another winter of fighting.
news.detailZh: 泽连斯基称，由于乌克兰远程无人机袭击扩大，俄罗斯领空将「实际上关闭」，意在迫使莫斯科谈判。普京指责基辅搞「国家恐怖主义」，称「我们不与恐怖分子谈判」，在被问及若英国继续武装乌克兰、俄是否会打击英军事设施时含糊其辞。美国主导的谈判迄今没有突破，双方都在为又一个冬天的战斗做准备。

businessTips.explanationEn: Unit economics measures the direct revenue and direct costs tied to a single 'unit' of a business, such as one customer, one order or one subscription. The core numbers are contribution margin (revenue minus variable costs per unit), customer acquisition cost (CAC) and lifetime value (LTV). If a unit does not make money after variable costs, growing faster only loses money faster, so founders and managers use unit economics to decide whether a business model actually works before scaling it. Healthy benchmarks are often an LTV at least three times CAC and CAC recovered within about 12 months.
businessTips.explanationZh: 单位经济学衡量的是与单个「单位」（一个客户、一笔订单或一份订阅）直接相关的收入和成本。核心指标是贡献毛利（单位收入减去单位可变成本）、获客成本（CAC）和客户终身价值（LTV）。如果扣除可变成本后单个单位不赚钱，那么增长越快亏得越快。所以在规模化之前，创始人和管理者用单位经济学来判断商业模式是否真的成立。常见的健康基准是：LTV至少为CAC的三倍，且CAC能在约12个月内收回。
businessTips.exampleEn: A meal-kit startup sells a box for $60 that costs $38 in food, packaging and shipping, leaving a $22 contribution margin. It spends $80 to acquire each customer through ads, and the average customer orders six boxes before quitting, giving an LTV of $132. LTV is only 1.65 times CAC and payback takes about four orders, so the founder pauses ad spending and works on retention and referral before raising the marketing budget.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家净菜配送创业公司售价60美元一盒，食材、包装和运费成本38美元，贡献毛利22美元。通过广告获客的成本为每人80美元，平均客户在流失前下单六次，LTV为132美元。LTV仅为CAC的1.65倍，回本约需四笔订单，于是创始人暂停投放广告，先改善留存和转介绍，再增加营销预算。

businessTips.explanationEn: Pre-selling means asking customers to pay, or make a firm commitment to pay, before the product or service fully exists. It is the strongest form of market validation because it tests whether people will part with money, not just whether they say they like the idea. Pre-selling also funds the build, sets a realistic price and creates a small group of committed early users who give feedback. It works through pre-orders, paid pilots, crowdfunding, or a paid waitlist, and is most useful for a solo operator or side-project owner who cannot afford to build something nobody buys.
businessTips.explanationZh: 预售是指在产品或服务尚未完全成型之前，就让客户付款，或做出明确的付款承诺。这是最有力的市场验证方式，因为它检验的是人们是否愿意掏钱，而不只是嘴上说喜欢这个点子。预售还能为开发提供资金、确定一个现实的价格，并形成一小群愿意给反馈的早期铁杆用户。它可以通过预订、付费试点、众筹或付费候补名单来实现，对于承担不起「做出来却没人买」的个人经营者或副业者尤其有用。
businessTips.exampleEn: A developer with a full-time job wants to build a niche invoicing tool for freelance photographers. Instead of coding for six months, she makes a one-page site describing the tool and a $99 lifetime 'founding user' offer, and posts it in three photography communities. Forty people pay within two weeks, which both confirms demand and gives her about $4,000 to fund development, while a handful of buyers agree to test early builds.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位有全职工作的开发者想为自由摄影师做一款小众开票工具。她没有先埋头写六个月代码，而是做了一个单页网站介绍这款工具，并推出99美元的「创始用户」终身方案，发到三个摄影社群里。两周内有40人付款，既验证了需求，又筹得约4000美元用于开发，其中几位买家还同意试用早期版本。

businessTips.explanationEn: Dollar-cost averaging (DCA) is investing a fixed amount of money at regular intervals, for example every payday, regardless of whether prices are up or down. Because the fixed sum buys more shares when prices are low and fewer when prices are high, the average purchase price tends to be smoother than trying to time a lump sum. The main benefit is behavioral: it removes the pressure to predict market tops and bottoms and keeps an investor consistently in the market. The trade-off is that in a steadily rising market, investing a lump sum earlier usually earns more.
businessTips.explanationZh: 定投（美元成本平均法）是指每隔固定周期（比如每次发薪日）投入固定金额，不管当时价格是涨是跌。由于固定金额在价格低时买入更多份额、价格高时买入更少，平均买入成本往往比一次性择时买入更平滑。它最大的好处是行为层面的：免去了预测市场顶部和底部的压力，让投资者持续留在市场里。代价是：在持续上涨的市场中，越早一次性投入通常收益越高。
businessTips.exampleEn: An employee sets up an automatic transfer of $500 into a low-cost index fund on the first of every month. During a volatile stretch, $500 buys 12 units at $42, then 14 units at $36, then 11 units at $45. Over the quarter he invests $1,500 and holds 37 units at an average cost of about $40.5, without ever having to decide whether 'now' was a good time to buy.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位上班族设置每月1号自动把500美元转入一只低成本指数基金。在一段波动行情里，500美元先以42美元买入12份，再以36美元买入14份，然后以45美元买入11份。整个季度他投入1500美元，持有37份，平均成本约40.5美元，全程无需判断「现在」是不是买入的好时机。
